versions.changelog:
**Initial release of ljh-xhs: Xiaohongshu (RED) viral image-text post decomposer.**

- Provides a structured multi-phase workflow to analyze and decompose Xiaohongshu posts, from sample qualification to actionable controlled-variant plans.
- Enforces strict sample grading (A/B/C/D) based on data reliability, preventing wasteful analysis on poor-quality samples.
- Guides users through explicit phases including user path reconstruction, cover and content factor breakdown, cause abstraction, variable layering, and experiment design.
- Includes detailed user onboarding flow and supports archive file integration for efficient repeat use.
- Output follows a clear, comprehensive template to support execution and learning.
